from_the_caption: Black arrows indicate Golgi stacks with electron-dense DAB polymer, which was deposited within cisternae across the entire stack.
Endo-lysosomal structures (black arrowheads) and ER cisternae (white arrowheads) did not contain DAB precipitate.
Endo-lysosomal structures (black arrowheads) and ER cisternae (white arrowheads) did not contain DAB precipitate.

DAB-negative, newly forming Golgi structures (“new” Golgi) are indicated by white arrows and were initially represented by vacuolar clusters (B) located near ER exit sites (white arrowhead in B), irregular stacks (C and insets 1, 2), or regular stacks (D, E).
vacuolar clusters (B) located near ER exit sites (white arrowhead in B)
Remnants of DAB-positive old Golgi were detected in the cytosol (black arrows) or sequestered inside lysosomes (black arrowheads).
